check_command.description:
<summary>Check the status and recent output of a background command.</summary>
<returns>
<description>Status and recent output of the background command.</description>
</returns>

create_directory.description:
<summary>Create a directory and any missing parents.</summary>
<returns>
<description>Confirmation message.</description>
</returns>

path.description: Directory path relative to the root directory.

edit_file.description:
<summary>Edit a file by exact string replacement with conflict detection.

The old_text must appear exactly once in the file. Include surrounding
context lines to ensure uniqueness.</summary>
<returns>
<description>Summary with new hash for subsequent operations.</description>
</returns>

expected_hash.description:
If provided, rejects the edit when the file's
current hash doesn't match (optimistic concurrency).

old_text.description: The exact text to find (must appear exactly once).

path.description: File path relative to the root directory.

file_info.description:
<summary>Get metadata about a file or directory.</summary>
<returns>
<description>Formatted metadata including size, type, and permissions.</description>
</returns>

path.description: File or directory path relative to the root directory.

find_files.description:
<summary>Find files by glob pattern (name matching, not content search).</summary>
<returns>
<description>Newline-separated list of matching file paths relative to root.</description>
</returns>

path.description: Directory to search in, relative to the root directory.

pattern.description:
Glob pattern to match, relative to `path` (e.g. '*.py',
'**/*.json'). Absolute patterns are rejected.

list_directory.description:
<summary>List the contents of a directory.</summary>
<returns>
<description>A newline-separated listing with type indicators and sizes.</description>
</returns>

path.description: Directory path relative to the root directory.

read_file.description:
<summary>Read a text file with line numbers.</summary>
<returns>
<description>File content with line numbers, plus metadata header.</description>
</returns>

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return (default: 2000).

offset.description: Zero-based line offset to start reading from.

path.description: File path relative to the root directory.

run_command.description:
<summary>Execute a shell command and return its output.</summary>
<returns>
<description>Labeled stdout/stderr output with exit code on non-zero exit.</description>
</returns>

search_files.description:
<summary>Search file contents using a regular expression.</summary>
<returns>
<type>str</type>
<description>Matching lines formatted as file:line_number:text.</description>
</returns>

include_glob.description: If provided, only search files matching this glob (e.g. '*.py').

path.description: Directory to search in, relative to the root directory.

start_command.description:
<summary>Start a long-running command in the background (e.g. a server or watcher).

Callers MUST call `stop_command(command_id)` when done to terminate the
process and clean up temporary output files.</summary>
<returns>
<description>A message containing the unique command ID for later check/stop calls.</description>
</returns>

command.description: The shell command to run in the background.

stop_command.description:
<summary>Stop a background command and return its final output.</summary>
<returns>
<description>Final output and exit status of the stopped command.</description>
</returns>

write_file.description:
<summary>Create or overwrite a file with conflict detection.</summary>
<returns>
<description>Confirmation message with new hash.</description>
</returns>

expected_hash.description:
If provided, the write is rejected when the file exists
and its current hash doesn't match (optimistic concurrency).

path.description: File path relative to the root directory.
